title: Langchain lags is behind the master repo
body:
### Bug Description

I just encoutered a bug in the PerplexityAI Component, essentially the model parameters are named wrong and max_tokens is simply ignored, all these bugs have been already fixed in the main community langchain repo https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/issues/28229 .

The component at the moment works but it just cuts the output of the model and cannot be used properly. 

Current langflow langchain lib version: 0.3.21  ------------> latest is 0.3.26

### Reproduction

Steps to reproduce: 

1. Create project
2. add perplexityAi model 
3. component doesnt work because the max tokens parameter doesnt exisist in the python class.
4. try to execute the flow, your output will be truncated

### Expected behavior

it works

linked_prs.body:
Fixes #8952

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Documentation**
  * Updated documentation to rename the "max_output_tokens" parameter to "max_tokens" and removed the "top_k" parameter from the Perplexity bundle component.

* **Refactor**
  * Renamed the "max_output_tokens" parameter to "max_tokens" in the Perplexity component.
  * Removed "top_k" and "top_p" parameters from the Perplexity component configuration.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This issue involves an LLM operation problem related to incorrect model parameters (`max_tokens`) and truncated outputs, which aligns with the "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" and "Context length issues" subcategories of agent issues.
